beats.anchor: Le soir, Kaydoudou monte quand même sur le terrat.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou (12) in the sand gold Costa Daurada shirt with a navy band and green shorts, a woollen blanket wrapped around his shoulders, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, his soft little afro pushed by the wind.
beats.action: Alone at the low stone wall of the flat rooftop, Kaydoudou holds the blanket tight under his chin and stares south over the dark sea. His eyes are wet; the wind tears at the blanket. Far away, the small lights of ships.
beats.location: The flat roof terrace of a narrow tall stone house in a Catalan hill village in February: a low wall, a spiral stair hatch, bare vines on the hills on one side, the dark Mediterranean on the other.
beats.light: Cold windy night, deep blue sky with a few stars, tiny warm lights of boats on the black sea, a faint glow from the village below.
beats.camera: Quiet wide medium shot from behind and slightly to the side, the small figure against the vast dark sea.
beats.alt: Seul sur le terrat, dans le vent froid de la tramuntana, Kaydoudou regarde vers le sud, là où doit être l'Afrique.

beats.anchor: Avant de raccrocher, Mami lève sa canne vers l'écran, comme une épée.
beats.extras: The women of the njangi around her, all Cameroonian women in their sixties with dark brown skin in bright wax print dresses and headwraps: Maman Tchinda, broad and laughing loudly, in orange and green; Mama Ngo'o, slender, with round glasses, in blue and yellow; four or five others standing and sitting around the chair, clapping. One of them holds up a tablet facing Mami.
beats.outfit: Mami Nyanga (70): small, very upright, dark brown skin, a huge laugh, a red and yellow wax print headscarf and matching dress, glasses on the tip of her nose, sandals, one leg resting on a stool covered with a folded wax cloth.
beats.action: Sitting in a big rattan armchair, Mami raises her wooden cane toward the tablet like a sword, laughing and scolding at the same time. The women around her burst out laughing.
beats.location: Mami's courtyard in Bafoussam, Cameroon: beaten red earth, an old treadle sewing machine under a small awning, a clay wall, green hills behind.
beats.light: Warm early evening, golden low sun on the women's prints, long soft shadows.
beats.camera: Medium shot from just behind the tablet, Mami and her cane in the centre, the circle of women framing her like a bouquet.
beats.alt: Dans sa cour de Bafoussam, entourée des femmes du njangi, Mami lève sa canne vers l'écran comme une épée.

beats.anchor: Il s'accroupit et dessine dans le sable.
beats.extras: Laia Ferrer, 13: a white Catalan girl with her brown bun undone by the wind, freckles, soaked to the knees and shivering happily, crouching to look. Martí, 7: a small white Catalan boy with tousled light brown hair, kneeling, mouth open, repeating a word. The twins Arnau and Biel, 8: two identical white boys, one in a blue woolly hat and one in a red woolly hat. Pol Vidal, 13: tall and broad, and Nil Soler, 13: tall, very thin, sticking out ears, standing behind. All barefoot, trousers rolled up.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou (12) barefoot, in the sand gold Costa Daurada shirt with a navy band and green shorts, his red and yellow socks rolled into a ball in his left fist, his soft little afro dusted with sand, the gap in his front teeth showing. BriBri (14) in his green sweatshirt and rolled up jeans, barefoot, sitting on a blue and white fishing boat with Maman's phone in his hand, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: Kaydoudou crouches on the sand and traces a big circle with his finger, explaining with his whole face. The children gather round him in a ring, heads bent over the drawing. Martí's mouth is open on a word. BriBri watches from the boat with a small proud smile.
beats.location: A small golden sand cove at the foot of a Catalan village in February: blue and white fishing boats pulled up on the sand, a turquoise calm sea, two flip flops stuck in the sand as a goal, an almond tree in white blossom on the hill behind.
beats.light: Bright clean afternoon light after the wind, sparkling sea, sharp blue sky.
beats.camera: Medium shot at child height, the circle drawn in the sand in the foreground, the ring of faces around Kaydoudou, the boat with BriBri on the right.
beats.alt: Accroupi sur la plage, Kaydoudou dessine un cercle dans le sable pour expliquer le dribble njangi aux enfants de Vinyamar.
